text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly regarding handicap parking and transportation from the lot to the library entrance. Some guests expressed frustration with the timed-entry ticketing system, reporting confusion about the need to purchase tickets in advance and delays in entry. Criticism was also directed at the use of AI in exhibits, with some finding it poorly executed or distorted, and concerns were raised about the high proportion of replica items on display. A few reviews mentioned limited food options and crowding, which affected overall visitor experience. Despite these concerns, the library’s architecture and interactive exhibits received positive comments.
